import * as ARA3D from '../src/index'; import * as THREE from 'three'; async function runExample() { // Initialize viewer const viewer = new ARA3D.Viewer(); const loader = new ARA3D.BimOpenSchemaLoader(); console.time('Loading .bos file'); const bimData = await loader.load('/ara3d-webgl/rac_basic_sample_project-2025.bos'); console.timeEnd('Loading .bos file'); let group = bimData.ThreeGeometry; const originalGroup = bimData.ThreeGeometry; // Store reference to original geometry viewer.add(group); // Selection state const selectedGlobalIds = new Set(); let pointerDownPos = null; const DRAG_THRESHOLD = 5; // pixels const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster(); // Ghost material for non-selected instances const ghostMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x88aaff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.1, roughness: 0.8, metalness: 0.0, depthWrite: false, }); // Decode raycast hit to InstanceIndex using pick metadata function decodeHitToInstanceIndex(object, intersection) { const pickData = object.userData.pick; if (!pickData) return null; if (pickData.kind === 'single') { return pickData.instanceIndex; } else if (pickData.kind === 'instanced') { // intersection.instanceId is the index into the InstancedMesh if (intersection.instanceId !== undefined && pickData.instanceIndices) { return pickData.instanceIndices[intersection.instanceId]; } return null; } else if (pickData.kind === 'merged') { // intersection.faceIndex is the triangle index if (intersection.faceIndex !== undefined && pickData.triToInstanceIndex) { return pickData.triToInstanceIndex[intersection.faceIndex]; } return null; } return null; } // Update geometry based on selection function rebuildGeometryWithSelection() { const instances = []; for (const instance of bimData.Instances) { const globalId = bimData.Resolver.GetInstanceGlobalId(instance); if (selectedGlobalIds.has(globalId)) { // Selected: keep original material instances.push(instance); } else { // Non-selected: apply ghost material instances.push({ ...instance, material: ghostMaterial }); } } const newGroup = bimData.rebuildGeometry(instances); viewer.remove(group); group = newGroup; viewer.add(group); // Update UI updateSelectionPanel(); } // Reset to initial state - restore original geometry function resetSelection() { selectedGlobalIds.clear(); viewer.remove(group); group = originalGroup; viewer.add(group); updateSelectionPanel(); } // Handle pointer events for picking function handlePointerDown(event) { if (event.button !== 0) return; // Only handle left mouse button pointerDownPos = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY }; } function handlePointerUp(event) { if (event.button !== 0) return; // Only handle left mouse button if (!pointerDownPos) return; // Check if this was a drag (not a click) const dx = event.clientX - pointerDownPos.x; const dy = event.clientY - pointerDownPos.y; const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy); if (distance > DRAG_THRESHOLD) { pointerDownPos = null; return; // This was a drag, ignore } pointerDownPos = null; // Get canvas and camera const canvas = viewer.viewport.canvas; const camera = viewer.camera.three; // Convert mouse coordinates to normalized device coordinates const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1; const y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1; // Raycast raycaster.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(x, y), camera); const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(group, true); if (intersects.length === 0) { // Background click - reset to initial state if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.shiftKey) { resetSelection(); } return; } // Object click - find the first valid hit for (const intersection of intersects) { const instanceIndex = decodeHitToInstanceIndex(intersection.object, intersection); if (instanceIndex !== null && instanceIndex !== undefined) { const instance = bimData.Instances[instanceIndex]; if (instance) { const globalId = bimData.Resolver.GetInstanceGlobalId(instance); // Determine selection mode based on modifier keys let mode = 'replace'; if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) { mode = 'toggle'; } else if (event.shiftKey) { mode = 'add'; } // Update selection based on mode if (mode === 'toggle') { if (selectedGlobalIds.has(globalId)) { selectedGlobalIds.delete(globalId); } else { selectedGlobalIds.add(globalId); } } else if (mode === 'add') { selectedGlobalIds.add(globalId); } else { // replace mode selectedGlobalIds.clear(); selectedGlobalIds.add(globalId); } rebuildGeometryWithSelection(); console.log(`Selected instance ${instanceIndex}, GlobalId: ${globalId}, Mode: ${mode}`); return; } } } // If we couldn't decode any hit, treat as background click if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.shiftKey) { resetSelection(); } } // Create selection panel UI function createSelectionPanel() { const panel = document.createElement('div'); panel.id = 'selection-panel'; panel.innerHTML = `

Selection

Selected: 0
Click: Replace selection
Ctrl+Click: Toggle selection
Shift+Click: Add to selection
`; document.body.appendChild(panel); // Reset selection button document.getElementById('reset-selection').addEventListener('click', () => { resetSelection(); }); } // Update selection panel display function updateSelectionPanel() { const countEl = document.getElementById('selection-count'); const listEl = document.getElementById('selected-list'); if (countEl) { countEl.textContent = selectedGlobalIds.size; } if (listEl) { if (selectedGlobalIds.size === 0) { listEl.innerHTML = '
No items selected
'; } else { const items = Array.from(selectedGlobalIds).slice(0, 50); // Limit to first 50 for performance listEl.innerHTML = items.map(id => `
${id}
` ).join(''); if (selectedGlobalIds.size > 50) { listEl.innerHTML += `
... and ${selectedGlobalIds.size - 50} more
`; } } } } // Register pointer handlers const canvas = viewer.viewport.canvas; canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', handlePointerDown); canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', handlePointerUp); // Create UI panel createSelectionPanel(); updateSelectionPanel(); console.log('Viewport selection example ready. Click on objects to select them.'); } runExample();
